children.characters: I propose a late-night coffee delivery service for night-shift workers, freelancers, and students. It connects users with cafés open at night for easy ordering of fresh coffee.

children.name: Welcome Message
children.characters: My target users are people who are active late at night and rely on coffee to stay productive. This includes night-shift workers, freelancers, software developers, designers, customer support agents, healthcare workers, delivery drivers, gamers, and students. They need a convenient way to order fresh coffee after midnight when most cafés are closed.
